msContents.summary:
[p]Miscellany of the works of Ramon Lull[/p]
[p][b]Contents[/b][/p]
[p]ff. 2r-4v blank.[/p]
[p]ff. 5r-8v Medical receipts in Spanish by 16th cent. hands[/p]
[p]1. ff. 9r-14v Ramon Lull, [i]Practica Testamenti[/i][/p]
[p]f. 9r Deus in virtute ute sancte trinitatis Amen. Incipit practica testamenti Magistri Raymondi Lulii de arte generali compositionis lapidis philosophorum capitulum 1mum De littera m siue de Mercurio. Tu provideas de liquore lunarii ... f. 14r ... sicut calor est est galline nutrientis ova sua. Explicit liber practice testamenti. Deo gratias Amen. f. 14v Alphabetum compendii sive apertorii vel condicili ... B prima principia ... Z separations liquorem.[/p]
[p]2. ff. 15r-17v Ramon Lull, [i]Ars magica[/i][/p]
[p]f. 15r Sequitur recepta. Ars magica naturalis. Magistri Raymondi data Imperatori Liber primus Prohemium. In die sancte trinitatis et eterne veritatis. Incipit Ars magica alias magica naturalis continens sua instrumentalia in quibus sunt virtutes ... f. 17v ... in eterna gloria et una tecum mereas vitam eternam. Amen. Explicit primus Liber artis Magice Magistri Raymondi.[/p]
[p]3. ff. 17v-18r Ramon Lull, [i]Epistola de plumbo et antimonio[/i][/p]
[p]f. 17v Requisisti me dilecte fili ut verbum secretum a philosophis occultatum de plumbo et antimonio tibi patefaciam ... f. 18r ... et ad pefectionem educunt desiccando. Lauda deum in hiis. Deo gratias.[/p]
[p]4. f. 18v Receipts in Spanish by one of the 16th cent. hands.[/p]
[p]5. f. 19r Extracts from Lullian receipts in the original hands and a sixteenth-century hand[/p]
[p]6. f. 20v Ramon Lull, [i]Litterae arboris philosophiae[/i][/p]
[p]f. 20v Littere alphabeti arboris philosophie in radice ipsius arboris. A significat Chaos in medio figure ... significat terram.[/p]
[p]ff. 21v-22r Diagram of the 'Opus philosophicate', etc.[/p]
[p]7. ff. 24r-v Ramon Lull, [i]Lapis occultus[/i][/p]
[p]f. 24r In nomine patris et spiritus sancti Amen. Recipe b. et pone m.s. prius in N ... f. 24v ... congela sicut scis super cineres. Deo gratias. Lapis ocultus.[/p]
[p]8. ff. 25r-33v Ramon Lull, [i]Tertia distinctio[/i][/p]
[p]f. 25r Hec est tertia distinctio seu 3us liber. hune valueris quia est de metallorum cura et illorum magisterium in compositione lapidis philosophorum ... f. 33v ... ut evitetur laboret fatigatio in practicando. Et sic finis 3i libri.[/p]
[p]9. ff. 33v-37v Ramon Lull, [i]Practica fundamentalis figurae[/i][/p]
[p]f. 33v Sequitur practica fundamentalis figure in hunc qui sequitur modum. Diximus de prima parte quod est theorica ... f. 37v ... tanquam finis et perfectio totius magisterii.[/p]
[p]10. ff. 40r-v Ramon Lull, [i]Arbor philosophalis[/i][/p]
[p]f. 40r Arbor ista dividitur in duas partes principales ... f. 40v ... et quia in questionario satis habebis de scientia figurarum et cetera. Deo gratias. Amen.[/p]
[p]11. ff. 40v-51v Ramon Lull, [i]Questionarium[/i][/p]
[p]f. 40v Incipit questionarius. Filii damus tibi doctrinam per questiones ... f. 51v ... quia impotentia charitatis felici arti repugnatur. Deo gratias.[/p]
[p]f. 52r Diagram, incomplete[/p]
[p]12. ff. 53r-73v Ramon Lull, [i]De cura inidividuorum[/i][/p]
[p]f. 53r Liber venerabilis magistri Raymondi lulii [rest of the line illegible from damp]. Ista regula infrascripta [superscribed] datur de lineis que oriuntur ab R.S.t.V. arboris philosophalis ... f. 73v ... Et idea datae sunt explicationes omnium principiorum et secundum ea que dicta sunt. Explicit totus liber. Deo gratias. Amen.[/p]
[p]13. f. 73v Tables, incomplete[/p]
[p]f. 73v Prima tabula de tabulis tenet figuram S. ... 3a tabula dat modum faciendi elixir ex saturno et rationem ut fiat ex eis sol et luna ... [/p]

msItem.title: Miscellany of the works of Ramon Lull

objectDesc.supportDesc: 1 volume73 ff. 4to. 21 x 14 1/2 cm. Modern vellum binding. Piece cut out of lower outer corner of fol. 14. The end is wanting. Margins have been cropped in rebinding. The first leaf-in the present foliation fol. I-is vellum, and was probably a fly-leaf of the volume as originally bound: it is slightly wormed. Written in a small semi-current gothic hand, probably Italian. Ff. 9r, 10r, 21v, 22, 42v and 52r contain pen-drawn figures: on f. 14r is drawing of an alchemical still. Fol. 1 Latin receipt in a 15th cent. hand for 'Aqua mirabilis' for the eyes: below a receipt in a 16th cent. hand. Under this in an early 17th cent. hand 'Raimundi Lulii e Maiorica/de lapidis Philosphorum constructione/et transmutatione metallica'. .

custodialHist.custEvent: Manuscripts in CALM were exported and transformed into TEI as part of the Wellcome Collection Transformation Programme 2026.

Catalogue description modified in 2014. For original description, see S.A.J. Moorat, [i]Catalogue of Western Manuscripts on Medicine and Science in the Wellcome Historical Medical Library[/i] (London: Wellcome Institute for the History of Medicine, 1962-1973).

listBibl.bibl: At Wellcome Collection: This MS. originally formed part of a larger volume, in which MS. No. 444 [LULLIUS] and MS. No. 710 [RUPESCISSA] were included; the division into three separate belonging to what Thorndike, in his [i]History of Magic and Experimental Science[/i], Vol. IV, Ch. 38, has called the 'Lullian alchemical collection'.
